papers.title: BMP-2 and hMSC dual delivery onto 3D printed PLA-Biogel scaffold for critical-size bone defect regeneration in rabbit tibia.
papers.abstract: 3D printing technology has various advantages, and the incorporation of bioactive substances into the 3D printed scaffold provides the biological and architectural characteristics of the scaffolds, which is very important for obtaining a good osseointegration effect. In this relation, this study prepared a novel porous hollow cage poly(lactic acid) (PLA) 3D printed scaffold and combined recombinant human bone morphogenetic protein-2 (rhBMP-2) and/or mesenchymal stem cells (MSCs) with Biogel composed of gelatin and alginate. Then, the scaffolds were used to evaluate the resulting bone regeneration through both in vitro and in vivo tests. The experimental group was divided into four groups as follows: only PLA scaffold (PLA); PLA scaffold filled with BMP-2 loaded on Biogel (P-BG-B2); PLA scaffold filled with MSCs encapsulated Biogel (P-BG-M); PLA scaffold filled with both BMP-2 and MSCs loaded on Biogel (P-BG-B2-M). Then in vitro results showed that the PLA-Biogel-based scaffold increased cell proliferation, and the P-BG-B2-M group showed a higher alkaline phosphatase activity and bone-related gene expression than was seen with the P-BG-M group at all the time points. It was shown that four weeks post-operative micro-CT analysis showed that within the defect site the P-BG-B2 group had a significantly higher percent bone volume (BV/TV) than the PLA group and P-BG-M group. And, out of the defect site, the P-BG-B2-M group BV/TV was shown significantly higher than the PLA group (p < 0.05). Histologically, defects in the P-BG-B2-M group showed a homogeneous new bone distribution, however the P-BG-B2 group and P-BG-M group presented a notably higher bone formation in the internal region than in the proximal region of the bone defect site. In conclusion, the 3D PLA-Biogel-based scaffold adapted rhBMP-2 and MSCs with carrier PLA showed good biocompatibility and high possibility as an effective and satisfactory bone graft material.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文使用 PLA 熔融沉积成型而非 LPBF 金属增材制造，没有涉及应力遮挡或疲劳力学测试，与用户研究方向不相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper uses FDM-based PLA scaffolds instead of LPBF metal implants, and does not include any mechanical testing, fatigue analysis, or stress shielding evaluation.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发兼具生物活性和结构支持的3D打印支架用于骨缺损修复。
summary_zh.method: 制备PLA空心笼支架，复合BMP-2和MSCs的Biogel，进行体外和体内实验。
summary_zh.result: PLA-Biogel支架促进细胞增殖，BMP-2+MSCs组骨再生效果最佳。
summary_zh.validation: 通过体外细胞实验和兔胫骨缺损模型进行验证。

summary_en.motivation: To develop a 3D-printed scaffold that combines structural support with bioactive factors for bone defect regeneration.
summary_en.method: Porous hollow cage PLA scaffolds were fabricated and filled with Biogel containing BMP-2 and/or MSCs, then evaluated in vitro and in vivo.
summary_en.result: The PLA-Biogel scaffold enhanced cell proliferation, and the combined BMP-2+MSCs group showed superior bone regeneration.
summary_en.validation: Validation included in vitro cell assays and in vivo critical-size bone defect in rabbit tibiae.

papers.title: Selective Laser Melting (SLM) Technology for Jewelry Design and Its Application
papers.abstract: With the rapid development of 3D printing technology, applications in jewelry design and the other fields are also increasing. Selective Laser Melting (SLM) technology is also one of the important ways to make metal jewelry by one-time printing. In terms of jewelry design, it can print almost any shape of works, including empty shell structure, movable structure and special structure. However, there are still many design principles that need to pay attention to in the application of SLM technology in jewelry design. For example support structure design, internal structure design, mold polishing difficulty and post-processing design. This paper focuses on the support structure design and movable structure design, highlighting the great impact of SLM technology on jewelry manufacturing and processing process. Based on this technology, jewelry design and related exploration can not only meet the aesthetic needs of traditional jewelry, but also reflect the technical advantages of 3D printing in manufacturing, and can meet the actual needs in production more efficiently.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文专注于珠宝设计中的SLM技术应用，与生物医学植入物的应力屏蔽、疲劳性能或骨整合等方向无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on jewelry design and manufacturing via SLM, with no mention of biomedical implants, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 将SLM技术应用于珠宝设计，满足复杂结构制造需求。
summary_zh.method: 分析SLM技术在珠宝设计中的支撑结构和可动结构设计原则。
summary_zh.result: SLM可打印空壳、可动等复杂结构，提高制造效率。
summary_zh.validation: 无实验验证，仅为设计原则探讨。

summary_en.motivation: To apply selective laser melting (SLM) technology to jewelry design for fabricating complex metal structures.
summary_en.method: Analyzed design principles for support and movable structures in SLM-based jewelry manufacturing.
summary_en.result: SLM enables printing of hollow shell, movable, and other special structures, enhancing manufacturing efficiency.
summary_en.validation: No experimental validation; the paper is a conceptual design discussion.

papers.title: The Role of Epigenetic Functionalization of Implants and Biomaterials in Osseointegration and Bone Regeneration-A Review.
papers.abstract: The contribution of epigenetic mechanisms as a potential treatment model has been observed in cancer and autoimmune/inflammatory diseases. This review aims to put forward the epigenetic mechanisms as a promising strategy in implant surface functionalization and modification of biomaterials, to promote better osseointegration and bone regeneration, and could be applicable for alveolar bone regeneration and osseointegration in the future. Materials and Methods: Electronic and manual searches of the literature in PubMed, MEDLINE, and EMBASE were conducted, using a specific search strategy limited to publications in the last 5 years to identify preclinical studies in order to address the following focused questions: (i) Which, if any, are the epigenetic mechanisms used to functionalize implant surfaces to achieve better osseointegration? (ii) Which, if any, are the epigenetic mechanisms used to functionalize biomaterials to achieve better tissue regeneration? Findings from several studies have emphasized the role of miRNAs in functionalizing implants surfaces and biomaterials to promote osseointegration and bone regeneration, respectively. However, there are scarce data on the role of DNA methylation and histone modifications for these specific applications, despite being commonly applied in cancer research. Studies over the past few years have demonstrated that biomaterials are immunomodulatory rather than inert materials. In this context, epigenetics can act as next generation of advanced treatment tools for future regenerative techniques. Yet, there is a need to evaluate the efficacy/cost effectiveness of these techniques in comparison to current standards of care.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文是一篇关于表观遗传修饰促进骨整合的综述，未涉及增材制造或力学测试，与研究方向的工程内容无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a review on epigenetic functionalization of implants for osseointegration, but it does not cover additive manufacturing (LPBF), mechanical testing (static or fatigue), stress shielding, stiffness matching, or surface roughness characterization.

summary_zh.motivation: 综述表观遗传修饰对植入物骨整合和骨再生的促进作用
summary_zh.method: 系统检索PubMed等数据库，纳入近5年临床前研究
summary_zh.result: miRNA是主要表观遗传机制，DNA甲基化和组蛋白修饰数据不足

summary_en.motivation: This review aims to explore the potential of epigenetic mechanisms for functionalizing implant surfaces and biomaterials to enhance osseointegration and bone regeneration.
summary_en.method: A systematic literature search in PubMed, MEDLINE, and EMBASE was conducted for preclinical studies within the last 5 years.
summary_en.result: miRNAs are the primary epigenetic mechanism used, while evidence for DNA methylation and histone modifications is scarce.
